reason: Passive adoption signals report (#491, docs/changes/491-adoption-signals/proposal.md): module-size 44098->45119 (+1021), measured with `harness check-arch --json` (CLI 12.9.0) on this branch, whose merge base is main 7f33d1cb (origin/main at measurement). newViolations is [] and the only regression is this aggregate.
